Overview of the editor's shortcuts

The keystrokes and their functions

File handling
Ctrl+S   Save current file
Ctrl+OOffer to write file ("Save as")
Ctrl+RInsert a file into current one
Ctrl+XClose buffer, exit from the editor

Editing
Ctrl+K   Cut current line into cutbuffer
Alt+6Copy current line into cutbuffer
Ctrl+UPaste contents of cutbuffer
 Moving around
Ctrl+A   To start of line
Ctrl+ETo end of line
Ctrl+POne line up
Ctrl+NOne line down

Information
Ctrl+C   Report cursor position
Alt+DReport line/word/character count

expected.contentMarkdown:
## Overview of the editor's shortcuts

### The keystrokes and their functions

**File handling**

| Ctrl+S | Save current file |
| --- | --- |
| Ctrl+O | Offer to write file ("Save as") |
| Ctrl+R | Insert a file into current one |
| Ctrl+X | Close buffer, exit from the editor |

  
**Editing**

| Ctrl+K | Cut current line into cutbuffer |
| --- | --- |
| Alt+6 | Copy current line into cutbuffer |
| Ctrl+U | Paste contents of cutbuffer |

**Moving around**

| Ctrl+A | To start of line |
| --- | --- |
| Ctrl+E | To end of line |
| Ctrl+P | One line up |
| Ctrl+N | One line down |

  
**Information**

| Ctrl+C | Report cursor position |
| --- | --- |
| Alt+D | Report line/word/character count |
